According to the press, the launch trailer opens with Lucia calling Jason from prison; it shows the electronic monitor on her ankle during a shower scene, then Lucia firing a minigun from a helicopter above Vice City.
Lucia Caminos a appris à se battre avant: Lucia Caminos learned to fight before she could run: her father taught her, and life has been testing her ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary; a stroke of luck got her out. She and her mother come from Liberty City, and the good life in Leonida is their shared plan: Lucia means to get it on her own. Fresh out, she sticks to one rule: only smart moves from now on. A life with Jason could be her way out. She’s one of the two playable protagonists, alongside Jason.
Cal apparaît dans le second trailer aux: Cal appears in Trailer 2 alongside Jason at Brian’s boatyard, in a floral shirt and sunglasses, as a man who’d rather watch than put himself out there. His official introduction ties him to two worlds: working for Brian, with Jason, and his own universe of forums and radio frequencies. He isn’t announced as playable; he’s part of the Keys circle, the one Jason wants to move beyond.
Quatorze morceaux sous licence entendus: Fourteen licensed songs heard over the course of the video, listed with their timestamps by several media outlets. Rockstar hasn’t published the list.
Les titres de l’album officiel déjà sort: The official album’s tracks already out: six on the day it was announced, two on October 9, 2026. All 34 tracks arrive on November 19, 2026, with the game.
Rockstar Games et Atlantic Records ont a: Rockstar Games and Atlantic Records announced the album on September 17, 2026. It brings together 34 original tracks, written for the game, meant to “capture the electric energy of Vice City and Leonida”, according to the official message. It comes out on November 19, 2026, the same day as GTA VI, on streaming, CD and vinyl. Six tracks came out with the announcement, from Yung Lean to Keith Richards. Other singles have followed: “Don’t Chart” by Cardi B and “Suzuki” by Fuerza Regida on October 9, then “Flower in a Hurricane” by Justice on October 15.
Le même jour, Rockstar a promis d’en dir: On the same day, Rockstar promised to say more about the game’s music: a dynamic score and “the next evolution of in-game radio”. The album doesn’t say more: its tracks aren’t tied to any station, and nothing says yet when you’ll hear them while playing. The album’s official site, run by Atlantic Records, offers the CD at $19.98, the vinyl at $49.98 and a limited-edition vinyl at $124.98, which sold out in minutes according to TechRadar.
D’autres singles ont suivi : « Don’t Cha: Other singles have followed: “Don’t Chart” (Cardi B) and “Suzuki” (Fuerza Regida) on October 9, 2026, “Flower in a Hurricane” (Justice) on October 15.

Aucune version PC n’est annoncée : ni da: No PC version has been announced: no date, no Steam page, no system requirements. GTA VI comes out on November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. For context, GTA V came to PC a year and a half after the consoles and Red Dead Redemption 2 a year after: these are series benchmarks, not an announcement. According to the press, Xbox’s Matthew Ball wrote on October 7, 2026 that the game won’t be streamed to PC through the cloud either. Any “PC version” or “beta” offered today is a scam.
Le jeu est annoncé « PS5 Pro Enhanced »,: The game is announced as “PS5 Pro Enhanced”, with no details on resolution; the PlayStation page also lists Remote Play. According to VGC (August 28, 2026), Rob Nelson spoke of 30 frames per second on consoles, with a 60 option not decided: Rockstar hasn’t published this itself. The August 27, 2026 Extended Look was captured on PS5.
Officiel (PS5 Pro Enhanced), propos rapp: Official (PS5 Pro Enhanced), statements reported by the press
L’Extended Look est une présentation de: The Extended Look is a 26-minute, 48-second presentation that aired on August 27, 2026, first on Netflix and then on YouTube. Captured on PS5, it shows car theft, store robberies, the police, the game’s social media and Jason and Lucia’s everyday life.
Rockstar l’a publiée le 15 octobre 2026,: Rockstar released it on October 15, 2026, captured entirely in-game on a PlayStation 5, along with the story summary: Jason and Lucia, caught up in a criminal conspiracy that stretches across the entire State of Leonida. It plays over “Flower in a Hurricane”, a new single by Justice with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, also on GTA VI: The Album; Justice is composing the game’s original score.
Lucia Caminos est l’un des deux personna: Lucia Caminos is one of the two playable characters. Her father taught her to fight; fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Fresh out, she only wants to make smart moves from now on. With Jason, she forms the game’s lead duo.
Leonida est l’État fictif où se passe le: Leonida is the fictional state where the game takes place, with Vice City, the Keys, the Grassrivers swamps, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. The press and players see it as a reimagined Florida, with Vice City recalling Miami.
Vice City est la grande ville de Leonida: Vice City is Leonida’s big city, which the press compares to Miami: beaches, shopping districts, a cruise port and Downtown’s skyscrapers. Rockstar mentions Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, Tisha-Wocka and VC Port.
Rockstar a présenté six stations le 8 oc: Rockstar presented six stations on October 8, 2026: Flash FM (pop), Cocoteo FM (Latin music), Back Country Radio (country), AfroBank FM (African music), The Chamber 106.6 (metal) and Dirty South Classics (Southern rap), with hosts such as Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen and Burna Boy. On-demand podcasts are coming too, and for the first time you can listen to the radio on foot, using the phone and earbuds. Rockstar’s Music page promises the widest selection of radio stations and podcasts in the series, “from classic rock to talk radio”, without saying how many stations there are in total. The other station names going around come from stolen videos from August 2026: we don’t use them.
Le site recense 3 291 armes identifiées: The site lists 3,291 weapons identified in official media, including 3,291 named by Rockstar (Jason’s Girardi ES9, Lucia’s Klose K17, the Hawk & Little Morgans…). The Armory also explains the loadout builder, gadgets and ammo.
GTA VI est classé pour les adultes. En F: GTA VI is rated for adults. In France, the PlayStation Store and the Microsoft Store show PEGI 18 (drugs, sexual content, violence, in-game purchases). In the United States, the ESRB rates it M, for ages 17 and up. The press also reports USK 18 in Germany; the PlayStation pages for Australia and Japan show R18+ and CERO Z.
